backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files for reference in build planning.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide detailing prerequisites, preflight checks, and IC deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup and OKLCH-based theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/preflight-production.ts: Runs TypeScript compilation and asset verification before production deployment.
frontend/scripts/verify-assets.ts: Checks required static assets exist in the public/assets directory and exits on missing files.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component composing header, content sections, and footer within an error boundary.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client-side validated contact form with inline errors and simulated async submission.
frontend/src/components/ProductionErrorB: Error boundary that displays a fallback UI and reload option when runtime errors occur.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders the About section with title, paragraph, and a values grid using icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Displays contact details and a form, including sanitized phone links and structured contact info cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero banner with background image, headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons that scroll to target sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows service offerings in a responsive card grid with mapped icons and text from marketing content.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, navigation shortcuts, social links, and a UTM-tracked attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with scrolling behavior, mobile menu, and navigation buttons that trigger smooth section scrolling.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports centralized file paths for brand logos and hero background assets.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Provides static marketing copy for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on current identity and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, status tracking, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future query hooks; currently exports nothing aside from importing useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and light/dark theme color variables using OKLCH values.
frontend/src/lib/scrollToSection.ts: Provides a smooth-scroll helper that offsets scrolling based on dynamic header height.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, fonts, and plugins for typography and container queries.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Node-related build files using ESNext module settings.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration enabling React, path aliasing, and build/server options.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, features, issues, and notes related to header/logo resizing and production publishing.
